newsitem.title: UK: Halifax in talks over PPP stake -- report.
newsitem.headline: Halifax in talks over PPP stake -- report.

text.p: The Halifax Building Society is in talks with private healthcare group PPP about the possibility of taking an equity stake or even buying the company outright, a British newspaper said.
The Sunday Telegraph said talks had been held back by the society's scheduled flotation, and that nothing was likely to be finalised before the June float.
The report said PPP was also holding talks with a leading credit card provider and a major high street retailer, but the Halifax talks were thought to be the most advanced.
A PPP spokesman said: "Part of our strategy is to develop distribution networks through a variety of routes which may include equity."
